scope: Ethereum lock-mint and burn-release production wiring
issue_fixed: The governed gateway verified an EVM deposit and emitted X3RepresentationCredited, but no on-chain minter consumed that event; burn_x3_representation likewise marked a withdrawal burned without debiting the wrapped balance. The gateway therefore did not complete the lock-mint or burn-release lifecycle.
implementation: Add a runtime-configured DepositMinter boundary for the governed gateway.
Bind gateway credit to pallet-x3-wrapped with the route chain id, X3 asset id, proof-bound 32-byte beneficiary, amount, and full gateway proof id.
Bind gateway burn to the signed caller's account, route chain id, X3 asset id, amount, and withdrawal id.
Add full 32-byte proof-id and withdrawal-id replay maps instead of truncating ids into the existing u64 nonce space.
Keep mint and burn failures atomic with gateway status, pending-withdrawal, collateral, and event writes.
Add runtime-benchmark preparation for the wrapped asset and caller balance.
Move spec_version to 25 and regenerate runtime WASM hashes with two agreeing srtool builds.

verification.command: SKIP_WASM_BUILD=1 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 cargo test --locked -p pallet-x3-wrapped -p pallet-x3-crosschain-gateway -p x3-chain-runtime --no-fail-fast
SKIP_WASM_BUILD=1 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo clippy --locked -p pallet-x3-wrapped -p pallet-x3-crosschain-gateway -p x3-chain-runtime --all-targets -- -D warnings
SKIP_WASM_BUILD=1 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo check --locked -p pallet-x3-crosschain-gateway -p pallet-x3-wrapped -p x3-chain-runtime --features runtime-benchmarks
SKIP_WASM_BUILD=1 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo test --locked -p pallet-cross-chain-validator --features runtime-benchmarks --lib --no-fail-fast
SKIP_WASM_BUILD=1 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo check --locked -p x3-chain-node --features mainnet-v1

verification.detail: Two from-scratch srtool builds against cdee9080e agreed on x3-chain-25 compact and compressed artifacts.

negative_and_boundary_tests: A mint failure leaves the gateway transfer Verified and allows a later retry.
A burn failure leaves the withdrawal unburned, pending supply unchanged, and allows a later retry.
A second mint with the same 32-byte proof id is refused.
A second burn with the same withdrawal id is refused.
A non-32-byte X3 beneficiary is refused with the gateway's typed error.
The wrapped balance and per-chain/global supply move together on mint and burn.
Unsupported or non-representable external chain ids fail closed.
limitations: This proves the on-chain gateway-to-wrapped lifecycle with real dispatch and storage transitions; it does not prove a public-chain transaction.
The gateway weight for the new cross-pallet mint and burn is conservative and must be regenerated with the FRAME benchmark CLI before mainnet.
The production 5-of-7 signer ceremony, HSM policy, rotation, and external audit remain open.
No public Ethereum canary has moved value.
